name: DateInput
description: A component combining a calendar button with a text input for selecting and displaying date values in YYYY-MM-DD format.
usage: Provides both calendar picker and manual text input methods.
Text input includes automatic formatting to enforce YYYY-MM-DD pattern as user types.
Includes built-in validation for date format (YYYY-MM-DD) and validity (e.g., rejects Feb 30).
Supports external validation, error display, helper text, and required/disabled states.
Forwards refs to the underlying text input element.
design: The component wraps a clickable calendar button and a text input.
The calendar dropdown uses a Portal and is positioned relative to the viewport to avoid clipping.
The `onChange` handler receives a standard `ChangeEvent` from the text input, even when the calendar initiates the change, for consistency.
Styling aims to visually merge the button and text input, resembling the `TextInput` component but with the prepended button.
Uses design system tokens for borders, focus rings, text colors, and error states.
accessibility: The calendar button has an `aria-label` for screen readers.
The text input includes `aria-invalid` and `aria-describedby` for error/helper text association.
Full keyboard accessibility is provided for the dropdown calendar.

props.name: label
props.description: Text label displayed above the input.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Function called when value changes (from text input or calendar picker).

props.name: error
props.description: Error message to display (takes precedence over internal validation).

props.name: validate
props.description: Custom validation function called on value change.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Text displayed below the input when not in an error state.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS classes for the outer container div.

props.name: inputClassName
props.description: CSS classes specifically for the text <input> element.

props.name: buttonClassName
props.description: CSS classes specifically for the calendar <button> element.

props.name: touched
props.description: Set to true to enable validation error display (usually after blur).

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Function called when the text input loses focus.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the input as required (adds asterisk to label).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input and calendar button.
